name: ASSOCIATE_TOKEN
description: Associate a token with a Hedera account so it can receive that token. On Hedera, accounts must explicitly opt-in to receive tokens. If no accountId is provided, associates with the agent's operator account. For third-party accounts, a private key is required.

implicitBehaviors.behavior: Defaults to operator account if no accountId provided
implicitBehaviors.details: Uses agent.accountId for setAccountId() when input.accountId is not specified. The operator signs automatically.

implicitBehaviors.behavior: Third-party accounts require freeze + sign workflow
implicitBehaviors.details: When accountId differs from operator, the transaction is frozen with freezeWith(), then signed with the third-party's private key before execution.

implicitBehaviors.behavior: Token ID is wrapped in an array for setTokenIds()
implicitBehaviors.details: The SDK's setTokenIds() expects an array, but the input is a single tokenId string. The handler wraps it as [input.tokenId].

inputs.name: accountId
inputs.describe: The account to associate the token with. Defaults to the agent's operator account.

inputs.name: accountPrivateKey
inputs.describe: Private key of the target account (required for third-party accounts)

preflightChecks.check: Third-party account requires a private key
preflightChecks.failDetails: Third-party account requires a private key. The transaction will fail without it.

successData.name: accountId
successData.describe: The account the token was associated with
